text: {"lessons":["My account rose from NT$98,129 to NT$109,091 despite several monthly declines, and I made no trades; short-term fluctuations alone are not a reason to act.","Because price changes are random, I should not treat recent gains or losses as forecasts or try to time the next move.","I should review my holdings periodically, consider the risk of losses carefully, and trade only when a deliberate decision—not a reaction to recent prices—supports it."]}
